# cloudai-x threejs — vendor hub

This vendor has no single master skill; it ships 10 tools, each a command of its own.
`/design-tools:threejs <tool> <target>` runs that tool; `/design-tools:threejs` alone lists them.

**Request:** $ARGUMENTS

## Do

- If the request starts with one of the tool names below, run it exactly as its own command would
  (`commands/<command>.md`): resolve with `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/resolve.sh" <tool>`,
  load (`load: skill` → Skill tool; `load: read` → Read and follow, base first), brand contract before
  any write, run, report what changed. Read-only tools change nothing.
- If it names none of them, print the list below with one line each and ask which one — do not guess,
  and do not run two.

## Tools

- `/design-tools:threejs-fundamentals` — Three.js scene setup: cameras, renderer, Object3D hierarchy, coordinates. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-loaders` — Three.js asset loading: GLTF / OBJ / textures, pipelines, progress. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-materials` — Three.js materials and PBR. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-lighting` — Three.js lights, shadows, environment maps. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-shaders` — Three.js GLSL and ShaderMaterial. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-geometry` — Three.js geometries, buffers, instancing. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-textures` — Three.js textures, UVs, mapping. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-animation` — Three.js animation mixer, clips, keyframes. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-interaction` — Three.js raycasting, controls, pointer events. (writes)
- `/design-tools:threejs-postprocessing` — Three.js EffectComposer passes: bloom, depth of field and more. (writes)

Vendor card: `wiki/vendors/threejs.md` · vendor contract: Not a design vendor — it builds a competent scene inside whatever page it is given. React projects use the `core-3d-animation` plugin instead.
